raw:
The user wants UI strings for a mobile app list page in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage). Pull-to-refresh.

- s1: hint when pulling down
- s2: status text after fetching completed
- s3: empty list text

Avoid mainland terms. Avoid 刷新 → use 重新整理. Avoid 加載 → 載入. Avoid 數據 → 資料. Avoid 提交 → 送出. Avoid 當前 → 目前.

Common Taiwan pull-to-refresh wording:
- s1: "下拉即可更新" or "向下拉動以更新" or "下拉更新清單". Actually Taiwan usage: "下拉以重新整理" — but 重新整理 is the approved term. Note: "下拉" vs "往下拉". The instruction says 往下拉可以重新向後端取最新資料. So s1: "往下拉以重新整理" or "下拉以重新整理清單". Maybe "鬆手後重新整理" is typical mainland style ("鬆開刷新"). Taiwan style: "放開後重新整理".

Let me craft:

- s1: "往下拉，放開後重新整理" — hmm, but s1 is hint while pulling. Maybe "放開即可重新整理" when pulled enough, and "往下拉以重新整理" while pulling. But we only have one s1. Use "往下拉以重新整理".
- s2: after fetch complete: "已更新至最新資料" or "資料已更新". Avoid 數據. "資料已更新" is good. Or "已重新整理". Maybe "上次更新：..."? The spec says 取完後的狀態文字, so "資料已更新" works. Could be "已更新到最新資料". Taiwan: "已更新至最新資料".
- s3: empty list: "目前沒有任何項目" or "尚無資料". Taiwan style: "目前沒有資料" or "清單是空的". Avoid 當前. Use "目前". Maybe "目前沒有項目" plus maybe hint. Keep simple: "目前沒有任何資料".

Check banned words: none used. 下拉 is fine in Taiwan. "鬆手" is mainland-ish; avoid.

Output only JSON object with s1, s2, s3.

{"s1": "往下拉以重新整理", "s2": "資料已更新", "s3": "目前沒有任何資料"}

Maybe s2 could include time: "已更新至最新資料". Fine.

Consider "後端" — no need. s2 status after fetching: "已更新" might be enough but "資料已更新" is clearer.

s3: "目前沒有資料" — some apps say "這裡空空如也". Keep professional: "目前沒有任何項目". Since it's a list, "項目" is fine. I'll go "目前沒有任何資料".</think>{"s1": "往下拉以重新整理", "s2": "資料已更新", "s3": "目前沒有任何資料"}
